scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: node scripts/copy-fonts.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && esbuild public/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=public/app.js && esbuild public/appearance-boot.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=public/appearance-boot.js && esbuild public/landing.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=public/landing.js && esbuild public/smart-worker.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=public/smart-worker.js && node scripts/copy-smart-assets.mjs
scripts.test:contrast: npm run test:contrast:regressions && tsx scripts/check-current-contrast.ts --check-only && npm run test:contrast:skins && npm run test:contrast:landing && npm run test:contrast:glass
scripts.typecheck:contrast: tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck scripts/check-current-contrast.ts scripts/current-contrast.ts scripts/check-current-contrast-regressions.ts scripts/check-skins-contrast.ts scripts/check-landing-contrast.ts scripts/pixel-contrast.ts scripts/check-glass.ts scripts/prove-current-contrast-scope.ts scripts/measure-current-contrast-candidates.ts scripts/check-beta-access.ts scripts/beta-smoke.ts
